name: Advanced Filesystem: Presentation Processor
description: PPTX processing submodule of Advanced FileSystem: pure-PHP slide-text, speaker-notes and metadata extraction (ZipArchive), LibreOffice PDF conversion and Ghostscript per-slide image gallery generation, with a per-file dashboard and batch/queue processing.

suggests.libreoffice (soffice): external binary — required for PPTX to PDF conversion (prerequisite for per-slide images).
suggests.ghostscript (gs): external binary — required to render the PDF into per-slide images.
suggests.ext-zip: ZipArchive — required for pure-PHP slide/notes/metadata extraction.

project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Presentation Processor adds a PPTX-centric processing pipeline to the Advanced FileSystem framework. It reads PowerPoint files entirely in PHP with ZipArchive: it walks ppt/slides/slideN.xml to count slides and pull slide text, ppt/notesSlides/notesSlideN.xml for speaker notes, and docProps/core.xml for title, author, subject and dates. With LibreOffice (soffice) it converts a presentation to PDF, and with Ghostscript it rasterises that PDF into a per-slide JPEG or PNG image gallery (configurable format and width). Each file gets a job row (adfs_presentation_jobs) recording slide count, notes presence, extracted text/notes, metadata JSON and the generated PDF/slides-dir/thumbnail URIs. Processing runs on upload (queue adfs_presentation_process), in a batch, or per file, with a Presentation Info view (escaped text preview and thumbnail) and a dashboard of coverage stats. Every route and private-output download requires the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_presentation_processor' permission.
